get.description: Newest tanggalPo first. search matches nomorPo and supplier name. status filters DRAFT, ISSUED, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED, RECEIVED or CANCELLED. DRAFT and CANCELLED are stored. ISSUED, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED and RECEIVED are computed from the active inbound rows: ISSUED when nothing arrived, RECEIVED when every line is complete, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED otherwise. A draft stays DRAFT until submit; only an issued PO can receive goods. Cancelling an inbound takes its quantity back out, so a PO can go back to an earlier status. startDate and endDate are inclusive. sortBy is date (tanggalPo) or status, with sortDir asc (default) or desc; without sortBy the newest-first order is kept.

post.description: A new PO starts as DRAFT; use /purchase-orders/{id}/submit to issue it. nomorPo is generated (PO-001, PO-002, ...). The approval request must be a purchase-request (400 when it is another type) in status approved (409 when it is not). A missing request or supplier is a 404. One request may have several POs. subtotal, dppLain, nilaiPpn and grandTotal are computed by the server and rounded to a rupiah: subtotal = sum of (jumlah * hargaSatuan - diskon), dppLain (DPP nilai lain) = subtotal * 11 / 12, nilaiPpn = dppLain * persenPpn / 100, grandTotal = subtotal + nilaiPpn + jasa. diskon is rupiah per line. Sending dppLain is a 400. A request that has a supplier mapping, or has no PO yet, is ordered through the mapping: every barang line carries lineIndex, the supplier must have that line mapped, jumlah must equal the mapped qty, and an already ordered line is a 409; anything else is a 400. Only a request that already had a PO before mapping existed may skip lineIndex. Each line stores itemId and noSpk, read from the approved request payload by lineIndex, never from the client. hargaSatuan is the final purchase price and is frozen when the PO is submitted. Optional Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters): with it, the same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and does not repeat the write; the same key with a different payload is 409; a malformed key is 400. Without it the request behaves as before.

itemId.description: Catalog item of the request line; null for old POs

noSpk.description: SPK copied from the request line

qtyReceived.description: Sum of the active receipts of this line

receipts.description: Active receipts of this line, oldest first; cancelled ones are left out

get.summary: Get a purchase order with its lines and receipts
get.description: Each barang line carries noSpk, qtyReceived, sisa and receipts (the active inbound rows of that line: date, qtyArrived, statusQc, referenceNo and inboundId), oldest first. status is DRAFT until submit, then follows the receipts: ISSUED, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED, RECEIVED, or CANCELLED when it was cancelled. submittedAt and submittedBy are set by the submit endpoint.

put.description: Needs purchase-order.update. Only while status is DRAFT, 409 once submitted or cancelled, because the lines are replaced. Sends tanggalPo, picSupplier, persenPpn, jasa and the full barang list, which replaces the old lines; totals are recomputed with the same rules as create. supplierId, approvalRequestId and nomorPo cannot change: sending them is a 400. 404 when the PO does not exist.

post.description: Needs purchase-order.update. Only a DRAFT can be submitted; 409 when it was already submitted or cancelled. Sets status to ISSUED and records submittedAt and submittedBy. After submit the lines and hargaSatuan are frozen, so edit is rejected and the PO can receive goods. 404 when the PO does not exist.

post.description: Needs purchase-order.cancel. reason is required (1 to 255 characters). A DRAFT or ISSUED PO can be cancelled; 409 when already cancelled or when an active inbound received goods against its lines. Cancelling is final and releases the supplier mapping. No effect on stock. The purchase request stays approved, so a new PO can be made from it. Sets status, cancelledAt, cancelledBy and cancelReason.

get.summary: Export a purchase order as xlsx
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. One sheet with the header, the lines and the totals. Money and dates are real Excel numbers and dates. Works for cancelled POs too, which show the status and reason.

200.description: xlsx file, sent as an attachment

get.summary: Count approved purchase requests by ordering progress
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. notStarted: no mapping yet. partial: some mapping, not every line fully mapped. completeNoPo: every line fully mapped but some mapped row has no PO yet. poIssued: every line fully mapped and every row has a PO.

get.summary: Get the supplier mapping of a purchase request
get.description: Needs purchase-order.view. 400 when the request is not a purchase-request, 409 when it is not approved. Each line of the request lists the suppliers it is mapped to with qty and, once a PO was issued from the row, purchaseOrderId and nomorPo (null otherwise, also after that PO is cancelled). status is NOT_STARTED, PARTIAL, or COMPLETE when every line is mapped to at least its requested qty. remainingQty is clamped to zero when purchase qty exceeds request qty. Suppliers are never prefilled from the item master.

put.summary: Save the supplier mapping of a purchase request
put.description: Needs purchase-order.create. Only the lines sent are replaced; others stay as they are, so mapping can be done in steps. A line may go to several suppliers. Purchase qty may exceed the original request qty, which is kept unchanged. Total qty of a line, including rows already ordered, must not exceed 1000000; a supplier cannot appear twice on a line; rows already ordered are locked. 400 for an unknown lineIndex or a bad total, 404 for an unknown supplier, 409 when the request is not approved. Returns the same body as GET.
